description: List the user's connected accounts grouped by service. Use this to discover which accounts are available before passing the 'account' parameter to other tools. Each Google Workspace account also says which services it granted (granted_services) and which it did not (missing_services). Each Notion account names its workspace (workspace, workspace_id); when one email holds several Notion workspaces, pass the workspace name or id as 'account' instead of the email. An account whose provider no longer accepts its access is marked needs_reconnect: true. A call that fails for a missing permission is explained here, and the account is reconnected at /dashboard/connections.
name: list_connected_accounts
